# Yule tree

Type: Furniture | Internal ID: piece_xmastree | Source: Workbench | Season: Yule (Christmas) | Usage: Comfort, Decoration | Crafting Materials: Wood x10, Fir cone x1 | Support: Wood (from 10 to 100) | Loss: 1/8 vertical, 1/5 horizontal | Weak to (x1.5): Chop | Neutral to (x1): Blunt, ,, Slash, ,, Pickaxe, ,, Fire, ,, Frost, ,, Lightning | Resistant to (x0.5): Pierce | Immune to (x0): Poison, ,, Spirit

# Introduction

Yule tree is a buildable seasonal structure. It needs to be built within the range of a Workbench. It increases Comfort level by one to players within about 10 meters of it.

## Availability

The Yule tree cannot be built year-round. It can only be built during the Christmas season, 1 December – 6 January.

Categorias: Furniture, Grants Comfort, Seasonal Furniture
